unmapped.raw_text: Experience shipping Android apps used by real users.

parsed.notes:
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR contains required qualifications; no optional skills section appears.
Android architecture maps to Software Architecture; Android development, its named libraries/features, app shipping, debugging and performance optimization have no exact taxonomy entries.
Debugging alone is not treated as Software Testing; the posting does not ask for testing.
Product sense and care for UX are treated literally as soft qualities, not a requirement for a named UX technique.
APIs, authentication and secure data handling appear only in responsibilities and are excluded.
Strong experience, real-user shipping and career highlights do not establish seniority under the guide.
